plan: Queue jungle as primary. It is Xeebs's best role at 52.6% over 321 games (overall is 50.3%). Set midlane as secondary, not the other way around.
Stop queueing carry: 43.1% over 195 games is costing real VP. When auto-filled there, play the safest comfort pick, not a learning pick.
Comfort-hero rule for the climb: Khaimera. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Xeebs wins about 5.1 more games per 100 on it.
Xeebs's champion pool is 11+ heroes wide and the top three are only 40% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
Park Drongo, Serath for ranked: 37% over 51; 38% over 50. Keep them for normals.
The math: Xeebs is at 384 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 692.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: Xeebs is a closer, not a marathoner
insights.finding: Games under 28 minutes: 69%. Past 32: 42%. Press early leads and call objectives; do not let games drift.
insights.receipt: wins 11 of 16 short games vs 5 of 12 long ones, recent sample

insights.title: Khaimera is the long-term relationship
insights.finding: 178 games and Xeebs genuinely out-pilots the field on Khaimera — about 5.1 more wins per 100 games than the average Khaimera player. The hours show.
